# Color Grading Central

> > Professional color grading resources, tutorials, and tools for DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, and Final Cut Pro.

Color Grading Central provides cinematic color grading education and software tools developed by colorists Brett Lyon and Cory Wright. The site offers LUTs, presets, transitions, and comprehensive training for video editors and filmmakers working with industry-standard tools like DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro, and Final Cut Pro.

## Key Topics

- Color Grading
- DaVinci Resolve
- Premiere Pro
- Final Cut Pro
- Lumetri Color
- CineDream
- LUTs
- Cinematic Colors
- Color Correction
- Video Editing
- Filmmaking Tools
- Color Grading Software
- Brett Lyon
- Cory Wright
- Blackmagic Design
